frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: HII regions of M106 whose metallicity Yuan et al. (2022) list: one dot per region at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way HII layer's pink (hou-han-hii), as M31's and M33's HII regions use. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
